title: Wall Label, No. 1: Untitled (Cat, Poor Grammar)
object: Archival pigment print, 8 x 10 in, 310 gsm cotton rag. Image area intentionally blank.
wall_label: This is the label without the painting. Every element of the museum apparatus is intact. Title, date, medium, credit line, donor acknowledgement. The object itself is missing, and the label continues working anyway. Visitors report they can still see it.

notes.Medium line printed on the object: Screenshot on screenshot on screenshot. First infection c. 2007. Gift of an anonymous forum.

shop_copy: The label does the work. The image never did.
